_source: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, 'Estimated Costs of Crop Production in Iowa – 2026' (Ag Decision Maker, File A1-20), for corn following soybeans (200 bu/acre) and soybeans following corn (60 bu/acre), in USD per acre, converted to USD/ha (*2.4711). Preharvest machinery is mapped to field_operations; harvest machinery, drying and hauling are mapped to marketing_harvest.
